name: data_analyst_agent
description: Analyze datasets with Python code execution. Paste CSV data or upload files, get statistical insights, visualizations, and ML analysis powered by pandas, matplotlib, and scikit-learn.
useCases: Exploratory data analysis on CSV datasets
Chart and visualization generation (bar, scatter, heatmap, histogram)
Data cleaning: find nulls, duplicates, and outliers
samplePrompts: Here's a CSV of monthly sales data. Show me the trend over time and highlight any seasonality patterns.
Analyze this dataset: find correlations between columns and create a heatmap visualization.
I have customer data with age, income, and spending. Segment them into clusters and describe each group.
Clean this dataset: check for missing values, duplicates, and outliers. Recommend what to fix.
author: Albert Folch
